name: zju-learning-tools
description: Safely query ZJU learning services with a restricted tronclass-cli fallback, download official resources, and submit reviewed ordinary homework through an opt-in transaction.

interface.shortDescription: Query ZJU with MCP plus a safe CLI fallback.
interface.longDescription: Use eight focused workflows for authentication, course planning, assignments and grades, separately confirmed ordinary-homework submission, assessment notices and discussions, official resource downloads, Zhiyun classroom data, and a restricted encrypted tronclass-cli fallback when the MCP transport is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Review my current ZJU courses and upcoming todos.
Find resources for this ZJU course and let me choose what to download.
Summarize my assignment status without submitting anything.
Prepare these reviewed homework files and show me the locked preview before asking for confirmation.
If the ZJU MCP transport is unavailable, continue a supported read task through the restricted tronclass fallback.
Check whether my private ZJU session is ready.
